$schema_draft_comment: Candidate specification and semantic walk-through for protocol v2. NOT a frozen schema or executed experiment. All paths/cost parameters are candidate hypotheses only, NOT verified exchange rules.

research_task._task_content_hash_reason: Hash calculation excludes task_content_hash itself; null in unexecuted draft.
research_task.title: SHFE 螺纹钢日内突破与日线趋势过滤回测走查
research_task.objective: 在计入候选滑点摩擦与开平仓费用假设下，回测单品种 (RB) 15分钟突破伴随日线趋势过滤信号的净值轨迹与回撤表现。
research_task.hypothesis: 日线级别 PIT 趋势（21日/63日均线）作为方向过滤器，结合15分钟日盘突破进场，可能在特定震荡与单边切换阶段呈现动量收益；该假设仅为经验假说，在不同市场周期具有条件适用性。
research_task.expected_edge: 在候选摩擦设定下，策略期望年化夏普比率大于 1.0，最大回撤控制在预设容忍度以内。

data_requirements.pit_constraints: Replay must preserve strict bar-close-before-open ordering. BBO quotes must be bounded by real event timestamps and available prior to bar execution. Continuous research series must be separated from exact-contract traded prices.

research_task._created_at_reason: Unexecuted candidate draft; physical creation timestamp will be recorded on task dispatch.

experiment_spec._task_content_hash_reason: Hash of upstream task is bound here (and included in spec hash calculation); null in unexecuted draft.
experiment_spec._spec_content_hash_reason: Spec hash excludes spec_content_hash itself; null in unexecuted draft.

dataset_target._target_comment: Candidate URI for walk-through only; does not imply warehouse exists in repository.

method_parameters._seed_proposal_comment: Proposed random seed for stochastic components (if any); run seed resolved in Run.

contract_specifications._contract_spec_comment: Candidate parameters for walk-through; actual live trading requires verified exchange regulatory specs.

roll_policy.roll_execution_order: 1. submit market/limit order to close position in expiring main contract; 2. upon fill confirmation, submit order to open position in incoming main contract. Atomic netting across distinct contracts is strictly prohibited.
roll_policy.continuous_to_exact_mapping: Trading orders must bind exact contract codes (e.g. rb2305, rb2310); continuous index series is used solely for research signal generation.

strategy_spec._implementation_ref_status: candidate_unregistered_symbol; runner will reject execution if implementation is missing or unapproved
strategy_spec._strategy_note: Candidate parameterization for walk-through; not identical to frozen #481 contract.

cost_model._cost_model_comment: Unilateral rates. Close-today discount is an assumed parameter; verified exchange intraday fee schedule receipt is pending.

experiment_run._spec_content_hash_reason: Bound spec hash is included in run computation; null in unexecuted draft.
experiment_run._run_content_hash_reason: Run content hash generated upon reaching final state, excluding run_content_hash itself; null in unexecuted draft.

metric_metadata.missing_reason: Unexecuted walk-through draft; all metrics strictly null.

unit_definitions.annualized_return: decimal ratio compounded by 252 trading days
unit_definitions.max_drawdown: non-negative decimal ratio representing peak-to-trough drop depth (e.g. 0.08 represents 8% drop)
unit_definitions.sharpe_ratio: annualized ratio with daily return frequency and annualization_factor=sqrt(252); strictly null if return variance is zero
unit_definitions.calmar_ratio: annualized_return / max_drawdown; strictly null if max_drawdown is zero
unit_definitions.trade_count: non-negative integer count of executed trade fills
unit_definitions.final_equity_cny: CNY final equity at replay termination

result_evidence._negative_evidence_semantics_note: Negative return is an objective numerical observation. Whether it supports or rejects the hypothesis depends on predefined target criteria, benchmark performance, and independent review. It does NOT automatically mean strategy failure or immediate factor blacklisting.
result_evidence._metrics_policy: Unexecuted or mathematically undefined metrics are null. If executed, metrics are computed from actual equity/excess return series; zero return occurs if final equity equals initial (or genuinely constant); zero drawdown occurs if equity never drops below peak; Sharpe is null when unexecuted, sample insufficient, or variance is 0.
